title: Space
declined: Darth Vader's helmet: no characters or real franchises

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A slim white rocket flying upward with a pointed nose cone, a round porthole, three symmetrical fins at the base and a bright fire plume under the engine, with a yellow-white glowing core and orange flame tips curling upward.
cards.hero_colors: white body, red fins as accent

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white astronaut helmet with a wide curved gold-tinted visor, a ring collar at the neck and two small side connectors, empty and with no face.
cards.hero_colors: white shell, gold visor, small blue collar ring as accent

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite with a boxy silver body, two flat rectangular solar panels attached on opposite sides by short arms, and a round dish mounted on top.
cards.hero_colors: silver body, dark blue solar panels, gold foil accent on the body

cards.name: Space Gloves
cards.subject: A pair of thick white space gloves, each with a rounded mitten shape, a thumb and a ring cuff at the wrist, standing upright side by side.
cards.hero_colors: white gloves, orange cuff rings as accent

cards.name: Toy Spaceship
cards.subject: A small toy spaceship with a rounded grey body, a clear yellow cockpit dome on top, two swept wings fixed to the sides and a twin engine at the back, resting on its flat underside.
cards.hero_colors: light grey body, yellow cockpit dome as accent

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A six-wheeled white moon rover with a flat boxy body, a small round dish on a short mast fixed to the top and three wheels on each side.
cards.hero_colors: white body, black wheels, yellow dish as accent

cards.name: Star Map
cards.subject: A flat rectangular star chart lying on a table, seen from above, with simple star icons joined by thin lines and a round compass icon in one corner.
cards.hero_colors: deep blue paper, yellow star icons

cards.name: Astro Pouch
cards.subject: A silver foil food pouch standing upright, with a flat sealed top and bottom, a small round spout with a cap and a simple apple icon on the front.
cards.hero_colors: silver foil, orange cap as accent

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A grey cockpit control panel fixed into a spaceship wall, with a perfectly round dial, a row of round buttons, two levers and a small square screen with a simple wave icon.
cards.hero_colors: light grey panel, green screen, red buttons as accent
cards.surface_or_setting: the metal wall of a spaceship cockpit

cards.name: Airlock Hatch
cards.subject: A perfectly round grey metal hatch door set into a wall, with a rim of bolts, a small round window, a spoked wheel handle in the center and hinges on the left side, seen from the inside with a starry window beyond.
cards.hero_colors: grey metal, orange wheel handle as accent
cards.surface_or_setting: a paneled metal wall inside a space station

request.wishes: Use a lightsaber and Darth Vader's helmet
